description: Four analog drum voices in the 808 tradition — kick, snare, closed hat and open hat — each with its own trigger, level control voltage and output, summed through a compressor and a tilt equaliser

params.text: Sets the level of that voice in the mix, saturating it as it opens; with a cable in that voice's control voltage input the knob attenuates that voltage instead
Silences that voice in the mix
Sets the tone of the kick, brightening the click at the front of it
Sets the pitch of the kick, from 35Hz to 85Hz
Sets how long the kick rings on
Sets the pitch of the snare body, from 250Hz to 325Hz
Sets how much noise is mixed against the snare's body tone, despite the panel printing SNAP
Sets how long the snare rings on, despite the panel printing NOISE
Sets the tone of both hat voices
Sets the decay length of the hat voices
Compresses the mix: fully clockwise gives a ratio of five to one at a -10dB threshold with 22dB of makeup gain, and fully counter-clockwise leaves the mix uncompressed
Tilts the balance of the mix between low and high frequencies, and leaves it flat at the centre

inputs.text: A trigger here fires the kick
A trigger here fires the snare
A trigger here fires the closed hat
A trigger here fires the open hat
Sets the level of that voice, attenuated by that voice's DRIVE knob

outputs.text: The closed hat on its own
The open hat on its own
A voltage that follows the level of the mix, for ducking another signal
The four voices mixed together, after the compressor and the tilt equaliser

notes: no voice sounds until a trigger arrives at its trigger input; the module has no clock of its own.
